macros.name: DeclareNewFootnote
macros.doc: Service command \DeclareNewFootnote simplifies creation of new footnote levels with automatic footnote numbering.

macros.name: DeclareNewFootnote
macros.doc: Service command \DeclareNewFootnote simplifies creation of new footnote levels with automatic footnote numbering.

macros.name: defaultfootnoterule
macros.doc: The \defaultfootnoterule is usually equal to the \footnoterule, but if the \footnoterule was redefined in the footmisc package with the splitrule option, the \defaultfootnoterule will save the original value of the footnote rule.

macros.name: footnoterulepriority
macros.doc: The priority for the rule of standard footnote group is specified in the \footnoterulepriority command.

macros.name: SetFootnoteHook
macros.doc: a new command \SetFootnoteHook{⟨text⟩} is introduced. This command is used before a new footnote declaration and specifies an action applied for such footnotes.
